proof:
by
  have hxmem : x ∈ ({x, y} : Set (PersistenceSubmodule M)) := Set.mem_insert x {y}
  rw [h] at hxmem
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hxmem
  have hyx : y ≤ x := sup_eq_left.mp hxmem.symm
  have hd : x ⊓ y = ⊥ := disjoint_iff.mp hxy
  have hybot : y = ⊥ := (inf_eq_right.mpr hyx).symm.trans hd
  exact hy hybot
